column1: # CC-IMPOSSIBLE-LAUNCH: English spelling varieties that are BOTH right (British / American).
# Eric, 2026-10-19: "both spellings should be accepted". One pair per line, British first, tab-separated; either
# spelling typed for a prompt of the other is marked correct, in every mode and for every player, whatever their
# region. Read only by src/variants.rs. This is a grading list, not a sound-alike table: it never creates a cue or
# a bonus pair, and the words in it need not sound alike (learnt / learned).
# Left out on purpose, because they are different words and not spellings of one: whilst / while, amongst / among.
